title.narrative: South Sudan Joint Response 2024-2026

description.narrative: Result 1: Improved enrolment, retention and transition of learners in schools in AkoboResult 2: Improved food security and resilience to climate and environmental hazards for vulnerable, crisis affected communities, IDPs and returnees in Akobo and AbyeiResult 3: Refugee, returnee, host community boys and girls in Abyei are protected from violence.

SC in collaboration with Aidlink and CEF will implement a 36-month intervention to meet the immediate needs for crisis and conflict affected people in Akobo and Abyei locations in the sectors of FSL, Education and Protection.

The total people reach with this three-year project will be 23,682, of which 8,765 in Akobo and 14,917 in Abyei. Specifically, the following groups will be targeted: Children with protection concerns; People with disability; Internally displaced persons; Boys and girls with educational challenges; teachers, education volunteers, Parents Teachers Association (PTA) and School Management Committees (SMCs); (Most vulnerable) Farming households; Survivors of SGBV; IPC 4 and 5 households; and Line-ministries in MoGEI, MAFS and MoGCSW.
